We are BOPAS certified!

Quality and Reliability of Our Homes

How does BOPAS validate our high performance?

The Buildoffsite Property Assurance Scheme (BOPAS) provides independent assurance that our modular homes are durable, reliable, and meet high-quality standards. Through rigorous assessment and continuous evaluation, BOPAS ensures that our homes adhere to the best practices in construction, offering long-term performance and robustness.

What is BOPAS?

BOPAS, or the Buildoffsite Property Assurance Scheme, is an accreditation program that certifies the quality and durability of offsite constructed properties. This certification gives lenders, valuers, and homebuyers confidence in the longevity and mortgageability of our modular homes.

It allows you to get a mortgage!

With BOPAS certification, securing a mortgage for your modular home becomes more accessible. This accreditation is recognized by major banks and financial institutions, facilitating the mortgage process and ensuring you can finance your home with ease and confidence.

Modular and timber-framed houses are created using advanced technologies and production methods. We integrate high standards of quality and safety by adhering to ISO9001:2015 standards.

High production standards

About the technology


Modular house technology is a modern engineering solution that combines a classic frame system with a panel construction approach. This technology allows us to build high-quality residential buildings quickly and efficiently.


Modular and timber-framed houses are created using advanced technologies and production methods. We integrate high standards of quality and safety by adhering to ISO9001:2015 standards.


Quality control

We carry out continuous quality control at every stage of production and assembly. Our specialists monitor the compliance of all processes with the standards. This guarantees the reliability and durability of our structures


Quality of materials

The quality of materials is critical for the durability and reliability of the house. We use only high-quality and environmentally friendly materials that meet the highest quality and safety standards.

Basic principles of Trident modular house technology

Trident technology involves the manufacture of the main elements of a house, such as posts, beams, floors, panels and sections, at the production site.


Each section or panel is pre-assembled with the façade and interior finishes, including insulation, OSB roughcasting, waterproofing, vapour barrier and exterior wall cladding.


Installation

The house is assembled on a prepared foundation using Trident’s proprietary technology for connecting wall panels or sections. This technology ensures a strong connection and tight fit of the elements, which guarantees the stability and reliability of the house.

Would you like to find out more about our technology?


Talk to our AI-Assistant

Structural framework

The system is based on a combination of an American-style timber frame and Finnish wood processing technology (calibrated, planed, kiln-dried softwood planks with a strength class of C24).

Framework system

The load-bearing structure is constructed from calibrated, planed, kiln-dried timber of strength class C24 with a controlled moisture content of 12–15%, ensuring the structural stability and predictable performance of the structure under load.

Temperature and humidity conditions

The building envelope is insulated with non-combustible Class A1 basalt wool. The layers of the structure are designed to manage moisture and heat effectively, ensuring consistent energy efficiency throughout the building’s service life.

Spatial stiffness

The structural rigidity of the building is achieved through the use of panel cladding and engineered connection points, which act as stiffening diaphragms and resist wind and horizontal loads.

Factory quality

The panels and modules are manufactured in a factory environment in strict accordance with the design dimensions and assembly specifications, which minimises errors and reduces on-site installation time.


Construction details

Technical details

Design

Every component of the Trident Modular system forms part of a single engineering system. The structural design has been developed with energy efficiency, moisture resistance and spatial rigidity in mind, ensuring consistent building performance throughout its entire life cycle.

Our Manufacturing process

Production

How modular house is created

Take a look at the actual process of building a modular home — from the production line to the finished property. This video overview demonstrates the production process, quality control and attention to detail that define our approach to modular construction.

What you need to know

FAQ

Frequesntly Asked Questions

Questions we are asked the most when it comes to Trident Technology.

Is heavy equipment needed to assemble a prefabricated house kit?

No equipment is needed for sectional installation, but whether heavy equipment is required will depend on the installation method you choose.

What is the difference between installing small sections and installing large panels?

Modular construction using small sections involves assembling a house from a large number of small sections, which allows for highly customized designs.


Construction using large panels, on the other hand, utilizes large sections, which can significantly speed up the assembly process but requires the use of heavy equipment.

The choice depends on your needs and requirements.

Is it possible to assemble a house kit on your own?

Yes. We have developed three main installation methods for you:


installation in small sections;


installation using large panels;


modular assembly.


Each method has its own advantages and capabilities, and we are ready to help you choose the best option for your needs.

What warranties do you offer for the construction technology and the quality of the house?

We offer warranties of up to 10 years on the quality and reliability of the structural components of our Trident home kits.


We are also ready to provide post-warranty service throughout the entire service life of the product.
